_readme: Add a new film by copying one block and putting it at the TOP of the films array. Then run: python3 build.py. Fields marked DRAFT need Gurudath's confirmation before the site goes live.

studio.name: Videogrammer
studio.line: We write the song. Then we make the film.

films.title: Go Go Little One
films.translation: A Mother's Love, A Child's Wings
films.logline: A mother eagle watches her young one learn to fly, and loves it enough to let it go. A song for every parent whose home has grown quieter.

films.title: Prometheus
films.logline: The myth of Prometheus, who stole fire from the gods and gave it to humanity, retold as a cinematic music video: the punishment returns every day, but the fire survives.
films.note: Prometheus is the studio's most ambitious film to date: a mythological music film built around celestial environments, ancient Greek visual language and photorealistic character work. The song came first, and the film was designed backwards from it. DRAFT — Gurudath to confirm and expand.
films.provenance: Hybrid. Generated and composited imagery, original song, in-house edit and grade.

films.title: The Duel of Musashi & Kojiro
films.logline: Two swordsmen. One shore. No dialogue. The most famous duel in Japanese history, told in three minutes and a score written for it.
films.note: The Duel is the film that proved the studio could carry a narrative, not just a mood. There is no dialogue and no lyric — the score does the storytelling, which meant the music had to be written to a shot list rather than the other way round. It remains the clearest statement of what Videogrammer is for. DRAFT — Gurudath to confirm and expand.
films.provenance: Hybrid. Generated and composited imagery, original score, in-house edit and grade.

films.title: Long Road
films.logline: A road picture in three minutes. Two men, two cars, and the distance neither of them will admit to.
films.note: Long Road was an exercise in motion — the first Videogrammer film where the camera never settles. Every cut lands on a beat, which is only possible when the person cutting the film is the person who wrote the track. DRAFT — Gurudath to confirm and expand.
films.provenance: Hybrid. Generated and composited imagery, original song, in-house edit and grade.

films.title: Mughamara
films.logline: An Arabic-language release built around a single idea: that a life spent avoiding risk is the only one truly wasted.
films.note: Mughamara was the first Videogrammer release written in a language other than English, and it changed how the studio works. The song came first — melody, then lyric, then arrangement — and the film was designed backwards from the chorus. The gold in the frame is not a grade applied at the end; it was specified at the boards stage and every shot was built to sit inside it. DRAFT — Gurudath to confirm and expand.
films.provenance: Hybrid. Generated and composited imagery, original song, in-house edit and grade.

films.title: Stay Standing
films.logline: The first release. A song about staying upright when the reasons to have run out.
films.note: Stay Standing is where the studio began — the first time the song and the film were made by the same hand, in the same week, with nobody's permission. Everything Videogrammer does now started here. DRAFT — Gurudath to confirm and expand.
films.provenance: Hybrid. Generated and composited imagery, original song, in-house edit and grade.
